tape: The default CSP screen returned 13 names. Five are one bet: CIFR, WULF, MARA, RIOT and IREN cluster at 0.7+ correlation. IONQ and RDW are a second pair.
IV rank (52-week, CBOE) is under 16 on 9 of 13 names. Only SMCI (43), FRVO (35), MMED (30) and FCEL (17) sit higher.

Six of 13 setups use the Nov 20 expiry. TMPro's earnings calendar ends Nov 5, so none of those six is cleared. It does show SMCI reporting Nov 3, inside SMCI's Nov 6 expiry, even though the screen marks it clear.
Two quotes are wide: MMED and FCEL. MMED (25), PL (88) and RIOT (147) have under 200 OI at the strike.
Chart bars run through Monday's close; screen prices are tonight's. FCEL printed 20.65 against an 18.07 close, PL 18.57 against 17.36, FRVO 14.33 against 13.46.
Gamma scan: 20 of 25 names in positive dealer gamma (pinning), 5 in negative (moves get amplified).
